conclusion: The current locality-safe C25CC01 physical-data family cannot beat solid Zstd-19 by metadata/control/header reduction alone. A new physical/semantic representation is required.
rejected_directions: control-only byte shaving on the current physical payload
record-header-only byte shaving on the current physical payload
zero-control hypothetical for the current physical payload
required_next_class: Change physical payload/semantic-root ownership so mandatory recovery, locality and integrity facts are represented with less total information, or reduce actual physical payload bytes. Do not spend release engineering time on further payload-neutral metadata shaving unless new exact evidence changes this floor.
